the-four-canadian-highwaymen-or-the-robb: J. E. Collins spins a rip-roaring tale of the four highwaymen who terrorized Markham Swamp in old Upper Canada. Pursuits, disguises, and narrow escapes fill this frontier adventure from Canada's early days. Popular fiction with a genuine Canadian setting, written when such legends were still fresh.
higher-lessons-in-english-a-work-on-engl: Reed and Kellogg's higher lessons carry students beyond the basics into advanced grammar and composition. Sentence diagrams and careful exercises built strong writers. The classic text that taught America to write correctly. Generations of pupils parsed and penned their way to mastery with its help.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-altar-lamp: A 1913 entry on the altar lamp — the sanctuary lamp before the tabernacle. Augustin Schulte explains its undying flame. Its red glow marks Christ's presence. Oil feeds its watchful light. The sentinel of the Blessed Sacrament. Its chain hangs from the vaulted roof.
